set.body: Generate and commit compact SimpleITK H5 fixtures and point oracles covering noncommuting affine plus displacement order, LPS grid geometry, float/double and legacy dataset aliases; add malformed and unsupported-type failures, loader/operator integration, provenance/docs, and full spatial JVM plus JS evidence.
set.title: HDF5 adapter 3: SimpleITK fixtures, failure contracts, and closeout
